name: zolitron
description: This is the project of group zolitron-2

scripts.install:all: concurrently "cd client && npm i" "cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt"
scripts.setup:mac: python3 -m venv backend/venv && source backend/venv/bin/activate && npm run install:all
scripts.setup:win: python3 -m venv backend/app/venv &&backend\app\venv\Scripts\activate && npm run install:all
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd backend && fastapi dev" --kill-others --raw
